evidence.title: Pattern Craft - Modern Background Patterns & Gradients Snippets

name: Pattern Craft
summary: Copy-paste library of 250+ CSS background patterns and gradients for Tailwind projects.
description: A library of ready-to-use CSS background patterns and gradients — radial glows, grids, dots, noise textures, stripes and aurora gradients — with live previews and one-click copy. Snippets are plain CSS and Tailwind classes.
contains: radial glows, grids, dots, noise, stripes and aurora gradients
